card.name: Afatinib LUX-Lung trial references
card.fires_on: Mostly the letter L starting the trial name LUX-Lung after 'In' in afatinib label text. Also fires weakly on scattered words in oncology tablet labels, such as 'cular' in Ocular Disorders.

modes.label: LUX-Lung trial name
modes.description: The L that begins LUX-Lung (or the comma after it) when a trial result is cited in an afatinib or EGFR drug label.

modes.label: Scattered oncology label words
modes.description: Single words or pieces in EGFR or cancer drug labels, such as 'cular' in Ocular or 'with' before a combination partner.
